description: This file defines the 'FieldToRequest' class, a method operation for the MiniLang framework in OFBiz. It implements the '<field-to-request>' element, facilitating the transfer of field values to request attributes within a specific context during method execution.

classes.name: FieldToRequest
classes.description: Represents a MiniLang operation to copy a field value into a request attribute within OFBiz's mini-language execution context.

classes.name: FieldToRequest.FieldToRequestFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of the FieldToRequest operation.

methods.name: FieldToRequest
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the operation based on XML element configuration.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation, copying the specified field value into the request attributes if within an event context.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the operation.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a FieldToRequest operation from an XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the operation ('field-to-request').
